description: Height and Weight Limits for Trucks and Large Vehicles is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. Locations where the height and weight limits of the street facilities restrict trucks and large vehicles from safely traveling through or under them. Height limits include the posted (maximum safe) height for vehicles to travel under viaducts, overpasses, bridges, CTA “L” train tracks, overhead signage, and any other structure spanning the roadway. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are streets, restrictions, truck, transportation. The table has 25 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2026-02-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
